detail.longDescription: A personal project for digging deeper into Linux system programming, ObFUSEcate implements a file backed virtual block device that automatically performs compression and encryption as blocks are accessed. This virtual device can be mounted via FUSE (requiring no root privileges) to provide, effectively, a "live" compressed, encrypted archive. Written in C++, and intended to have minimal dependencies, it has custom 32 bit arithmetic encoding/decoding, ChaCha20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption, and CRC8 + XOR parity error-correction.
